create_parsnip_subparser: create a Parsnip instance and add a subparser with a named prefix for grouped CLI arguments
parse_args_with_parsnip: parse command line arguments using Parsnip.parse_args to get a DotDict of all parsed values
add_dependent_argument_parsnip: add a dependent argument to Parsnip that only parses when a specified dependency condition is met
copy_arguments_between_subparsers: copy arguments from one subparser to another using Parsnip.copy_arguments with an optional prefix
get_argument_kwargs_from_subparser: extract argument kwargs from an argparse subparser using get_argument_kwargs to inspect registered arguments
